evidence.text: Delos develops autonomous AI workers that integrate with business tools to handle end-to-end tasks across functions including marketing, development, design, HR, finance and customer support.

The worker starts executing its tasks immediately and keeps you informed through your usual communication channels. Workers Delos is GDPR-compliant and SOC 2-certified. zh.summary: 将带记忆的专业 AI Workers 接到团队已有工具与任务流程。
zh.judgment: 关键是任务稳定交付和明确监督成本；部署一个 Worker 不代表雇到可独立工作的员工。
zh.replaces: 团队成员在聊天助手中起草，再自己跨工具执行和反复提供上下文。
zh.product: 官网列出营销、开发、设计、人力及财务等 Worker，并描述 Slack、Teams 和工具连接、持久记忆与 RAG。能力为公司声明，本次未登录派发任务。
zh.customer: 企业知识工作团队是用户，部门负责人是合理买方。不同角色的任务与责任差别很大，不能用一个通用代理成功示例证明所有岗位都可替代。
zh.workflow: 公司描述选角色、接工具、交代任务，再通过已有通信渠道持续执行与反馈。可验证交付应包含审批、异常恢复和结果验收，而不只是代理持续运行。
zh.business_model: 价目明确区分 Office Suite 与 AI Workers；套件月价从 10 到 80 欧元，不能直接当作 Worker 价格。Worker 页面数值显示存在歧义，本次不发布其单价，企业条款需确认。
zh.traction: 官网称已有大量 Worker 部署，这是公司口径而非独立活跃或付费数。没有取得任务完成、人工兜底或客户续约对照。
zh.moat: 团队上下文、工具连接和角色任务库可能形成价值。原生企业助手、自动化工具与人工团队都是替代，需要比较每个任务的总监督与交付成本。
zh.funding_read: 融资可支持多角色扩展，但范围越广，可靠执行与支持越难标准化。下一里程碑应是一个任务族持续使用，而非只增加目录角色。
zh.risks: 过宽权限或错误记忆可能让任务偏离要求，工具变动会增加重试。自动执行若依赖大量人工救场，业务可能更接近专业服务。
zh.takeaway: 把角色包装连接到明确任务、审批和验收。先证明一种可重复交付，再增加人格与多工具范围。
zh.watch_next: 看无需人工救场的完成率、监督时间、每任务成本和角色续约。把启用 Worker 的数量同真正稳定完成的任务分开。

en.summary: Specialized AI Workers with memory connected to existing team tools and tasks.
en.judgment: Stable outcomes and supervision cost matter; activating a Worker does not establish an independent employee replacement.
en.replaces: Drafting in chat, manually executing across tools and repeatedly supplying context.
en.product: The site lists marketing, development, design, HR and finance roles with Slack, Teams, tools, memory and RAG. These are company claims; no tasks were dispatched.
en.customer: Knowledge teams are users and department leaders plausible buyers. Roles differ in tasks and responsibility; one generic success cannot establish replacement across jobs.
en.workflow: The described flow picks a role, connects tools and assigns missions, with execution and feedback through familiar channels. Approval, recovery and acceptance should complete delivery.
en.business_model: The price page separates Office Suite and Workers. Suite prices range from €10 to €80/month and are not Worker prices. Worker figures are ambiguous, so no unit price is asserted.
en.traction: Deployed-Worker counts are company-reported rather than independently established active or paid use. Completion, fallback and renewal comparisons were unavailable.
en.moat: Context, integrations and role tasks could create value. Enterprise assistants, automation and human teams compete on total supervision and delivery cost.
en.funding_read: Capital supports additional roles while broader execution increases standardization difficulty. Continuing use of one task family is a better milestone than catalog expansion.
en.risks: Broad access or wrong memory can misdirect work; changed tools increase retries. Heavy human fallback would create service-like economics.
en.takeaway: Connect role packaging to explicit tasks, approvals and acceptance. Prove one repeatable outcome before broadening personality and tool scope.
en.watch_next: Watch completion without rescue, supervision, cost per task and role renewals. Activated Workers are distinct from consistently completed tasks.
